global.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
global.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

global.summaryKo: 엔비디아 임시 CEO가 젠슨 황의 갑작스러운 퇴임에도 오픈소스 AI 전략을 유지하고 Hugging Face 인수 계획도 이어가겠다고 재확인했다.
global.summaryEn: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed the company's open source AI strategy and its plan to acquire Hugging Face despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

global.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
global.summary: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
global.summaryKo: OpenAI가 GPT-6.2 Astra와 Sol을 출시했다. 전문 업무 결과물, 코딩, 컴퓨터 사용 능력과 효율을 높이면서 비용은 낮췄으며 ChatGPT Work, Codex, API에서 제공된다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, improving professional outputs, coding, computer use and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.

global.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
